current_answer: Choose by the frontend bottleneck and proof path: OpenAI Frontend App Builder for a new visual surface only when you can create and approve an Image Gen concept and compare a browser render; Anthropic Frontend Design for text-led visual direction; Vercel React Composition Patterns for a flag-heavy React component; Vercel React View Transitions for meaningful interface motion; Agent Browser 0.38.1 for a runnable UI whose states you need to navigate, inspect, and capture; Agent Browser Dogfood 0.38.1 for exploratory QA that must leave reproducible browser evidence; OpenAI Product Design Audit for a real user flow you can capture and review; Vercel Web Design Guidelines for a code-first UI review; and Vercel React Best Practices for React or Next.js performance. Dogfood can document a failure in a runnable flow; it cannot enforce your design system or declare the design right. Then make the adoption decision: target agent, project or global scope, source pin, local edits, update review, and required proof tools. The nine listings are source-pinned, but none has been independently result-tested by this pool.
